prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in, copy changes remain helpful, winning 5 out of 14 tests (+1.2% average after noise correction), while 9 showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, winning 4 out of 12 tests (+1.6% average after noise correction), while 8 showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes are helpful, winning 5 out of 11 tests (+1.9% average after noise correction), while 1 performed worse and 5 showed no clear effect.
choose_path, redesign changes are helpful, winning 2 out of 6 tests (+1.6% average after noise correction), while 4 showed no clear effect.
choose_path, copy, finish, redesign, finish, new_screen, home, new_flow, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.
Predictions were overly optimistic for finish, new_screen, finish, redesign, choose_path, copy, home, new_flow, and adoption, layout changes, predicting gains where actual results were mostly negative or showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Diagnostic Wait Info: Display a progress bar with a time estimate and tray icon tip while the app initializes the desktop window overlay. (why: Users wait a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen, and 3 support emails mention pets failing to appear on the desktop.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Two-Column Path Choice Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column view comparing instant starter companions side-by-side with custom creation. (why: Redesign changes on choose_path showed positive historical test results (+1.6% average gain).)
2: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Access System Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications and add system tray interaction hints to the welcome screen. (why: The finish step drops off to 77.0%, and support reported user confusion around how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Verification Sub-Flow: Insert a companion trait preview validation sub-flow right before issuing the adoption certificate. (why: 3 support tickets involved custom pet results looking wrong or failing during generation.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop System Tray Controls Guide Screen: Add a system tray controls guide screen after home introduction to explain how to hide, summon, or talk to the pet. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 77%, and support received multiple complaints about unclear post-onboarding controls.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Asset Initialization Step Counter: Display step counters and active asset load status text during the waiting phase. (why: Wait info changes consistently win on the home step (+1.6% gain), helping manage long waiting times (mean 2336s).)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Switch Reassurance Hint: Display a hint reassuring users that additional pets can be added later regardless of the selected path. (why: Reduces decision friction on choose_path, which has an 85.7% conversion rate.)

scores.note: home wait_info changes have strong historical evidence (+1.6% across 12 tests) and directly address long wait times and support complaints.
choose_path redesign shows consistent positive historical lift (+1.6% over 6 tests), though cost is high due to screen redesign.
Targets the highest drop-off step (finish at 77%) with strong support signal, though finish step changes generally perform poorly.
Adoption has low drop-off (93.3% conversion) and new flows carry higher implementation cost, but single test precedent was positive.
finish new_screen changes consistently underperformed (-1.4% avg across 6 tests) despite strong support signals.
home wait_info interventions are proven (+1.6% avg lift) and address long median wait times on the home step.
Low cost hint on choose_path with positive preliminary test history (+1.1% lift across 2 tests).
